issues.desc: 장병완 end date 2008-02-04 rests on the 이임식 date (연합뉴스, 문화일보) and Wikipedia. The date the resignation was formally accepted (의원면직) was not found. News of 2008-01-28 said acceptance was expected around 2008-02-01, and the 2008-02-09 filing deadline bounds it.

Verifier resumed pass. 서울경제 2006-07-04 has the 임명장 before the 국무회의, so the handover to the 차관 on 2006-07-04 is same-day. Severity lowered, end_confidence high.

Same-day handovers used where the outgoing minister moved to another post on the successor's appointment date (2000-08-07 진념, 2002-01-29 전윤철, 2004-01-02 박봉흠). The Wikipedia list gives the predecessor's end one day earlier in each case (2000-08-06, 2002-01-28, 2004-01-01).
장승우 end inferred from the successor (2003-02-27). Wikipedia gives 2003-02-26. A 2003-02-26 news item still calls him the sitting minister.

김병일 end 2005-01-27 is the day the resignation was accepted (사표 수리, 동아일보 2005-01-27, 경향신문 2005-01-28) and of the 이임식. The successor was appointed 2005-01-28. Hanja differs between the gazette (金炳日, used) and Wikipedia (金秉日).

진념 was 기획예산위원회 위원장 (not a 국무위원) up to the 1999-05-24 reorganization and was appointed first 기획예산처장관 that day. reorg_continuation=true and reappointed_on_reorg=true describe this, but there is no in-scope predecessor spell.

Vacancies with acting heads are 2006-07-04..2006-07-20 (차관 장병완), 2008-02-05..2008-02-28 (차관 반장식, ministry abolished 2008-02-29 without a new minister), 2026-01-02..2026-03-24 (차관 임기근, first nominee 이혜훈 withdrawn 2026-01-25). No other gaps. Handovers on 2000-08-07, 2002-01-29, 2003-02-27 and 2004-01-02 are same-day. 김병일 (end 2005-01-27) to 변양균 (start 2005-01-28) has no vacant day.

Nobody from the budget lineage continued across the 2008-02-29 or 2026-01-02 reorganizations.
